title: Myanmar’s Resistance Finally Has a Unified Front
author: Zaw Wai Soe
text:
Civil defense trainees attend a graduation ceremony for a capacity building program run by the Defense Ministry of Myanmar’s National Unity Government in Sagaing Region, Myanmar, Apr. 19, 2026.
Credit: Facebook/Ministry of Defence – National Unity Government of Myanmar﻿
I was serving as Dean of the University of Medicine in Yangon when Myanmar’s military staged its coup in February 2021. Overnight, I became an activist in the resistance movement, serving in a variety of roles. Like millions of my fellow citizens, I joined peaceful protests and helped lead the Civil Disobedience Movement.My involvement soon made me a wanted man, forcing me to flee to a neighboring country before I eventually received refuge in Europe. I was later appointed minister of health and education in the National Unity Government (NUG), which was formed in April 2021 to lead the resistance to the coup.[...]
